scouting.summary: Comes forward swinging hooks and overhands, takes one to give one, and looks for the knockout.
strengths: Heavy power and a hard chin
weaknesses: Gasses if the fight goes long
scouting.tell: When his jab is blocked he loads up the overhand.
scouting.how_to_beat: Move, make him miss and counter. Take him down when he's swinging, and drag it into the late rounds.
